<solar/>Scorch and <solar/>Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 5% increased damage.

Direct Hits with Charged Shots apply <solar/>20|40|60 Scorch Stacks at Charge Level 1|2|3. Scorch application is unaffected by <solar/>Ember of Ashes. 

Grants 10% increased damage to <solar/>Scorched enemies.
